name: Cécile Dubois
title: Mid-level QA Automation Engineer
summary: A detail-oriented and proactive Mid-level QA Automation Engineer with over 5 years of experience in designing, developing, and executing automated test suites. Proven ability to enhance software quality, accelerate release cycles, and improve overall testing efficiency for complex web and mobile applications.

bullets: Developed and maintained over 300 automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver and Java, reducing manual testing effort by 40% and accelerating regression testing cycles.
Integrated automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, leading to a 25% decrease in critical bug detection post-deployment.
Collaborated with development teams to implement BDD practices, improving test coverage by 15% and aligning testing with business requirements.
Mentored junior QA engineers on automation best practices and framework usage.
Designed and executed automated tests for web applications using Cypress and JavaScript, increasing testing efficiency by 30%.
Contributed to the development of a reusable test automation library, reducing script creation time by 20%.
Performed comprehensive functional, regression, and cross-browser testing, identifying an average of 15 critical defects per release cycle.
Executed manual test cases for new features and bug fixes across multiple platforms, ensuring high quality before release.
Reported and tracked defects using Jira, providing clear and concise reproduction steps for development teams.
Participated in daily stand-ups and sprint reviews within an Agile development environment.

education.institution: INSA Lyon (Institut National des Sciences Appliquées de Lyon)
